faqs.question: What causes a faucet to leak?
faqs.answer: Common causes of faucet leaks include worn washers, damaged cartridges, broken seals, loose connections and mineral buildup.

faqs.question: Can a dripping faucet be repaired?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many dripping faucets can be repaired by replacing damaged internal components such as cartridges, seals or washers.

faqs.question: When should I replace my faucet instead of repairing it?
faqs.answer: Replacement may be better when a faucet is severely damaged, outdated, corroded or requires frequent repairs.

faqs.question: How long does faucet repair take?
faqs.answer: Repair time depends on the faucet type, problem severity and required replacement parts.

faqs.question: Can faucet leaks increase water bills?
faqs.answer: Yes. A continuously dripping faucet can waste water over time and may increase utility costs.

faqs.question: Do plumbers repair kitchen and bathroom faucets?
faqs.answer: Yes. Professional plumbers can repair kitchen faucets, bathroom faucets, shower faucets and other water fixtures.
